persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalla devasana cūkavāsadevapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni aitāhutiyajñayāṅāyā thva sāphuri

date.as_written: saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukla daśamī mūla śaniścaravāra kuhnu || saṃ 825

notes: The manuscript was produced for King Jayabhūpatīndramalla on the occasion of the cūkavāsadeva-pratiṣṭhā and siddhāgni aitāhuti yajña.
